Physical.name: Unlock
Physical.description: Opens Lv. 1 doors with a 30% chance. Also opens treasure chests with a 100% chance.

Physical.name: Backstab
Physical.description: Supplements P. Atk. with 1107 Power to strike an enemy's unprotected back. Available when equipped with a dagger or a dual dagger. Over-hit, critical hit and half-kill are possible.

Physical.name: Sting
Physical.description:
Attacks an enemy with 82 Power added to P. Atk., and inflicts Bleed causing loss of 25 HP per second, inflicts minor damage based on walked distance.
Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.

Physical.name: Deadly Blow
Physical.description: Attacks the target's vital points with 1107 Power added to P. Atk. Over-hit. Half-kill.

Physical.name: Blinding Blow
Physical.description:
Inflicts physical damage. Power: 2751.
Turns enemy's back to you with 80% probability.
Applies to your character:
Speed +40.
Half-kill, Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.

Physical.name: Lethal Blow
Physical.description:
Inflicts physical damage. Power: 4348.
Half-kill, Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.

Physical.name: Escape Shackle
Physical.description: Allows you to escape from a captured state (Physical and Magical root).

Physical.name: Razor Rain
Physical.description:
Inflicts physical damage on nearby enemies. Power: 500 in PvP, 625 in PvE.
Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Shares reuse time with 'Deadly Blow'.

Magical.name: Confusion
Magical.description: Throws an enemy into confusion, changing their target of attack.

Magical.name: Drain Health
Magical.description: Inflicts dark damage on the target with 20 Power added to M. Atk. Absorbs 20% of the damage inflicted on target as HP.

Evasion +20
Chance to evade P./M. Skills +25%
Resistance to buff-canceling attacks +80%.

Chance of Blow-Skills +30%

Side P. Crit. Damage +15%
Back P. Crit. Damage +30%.

Buff.name: Counterattack
Buff.description:
Reflects 50% of melee damage received.
Reflects damage from melee P. Skills with 90% probability.
Reflects damage from M. Skills with 50% probability.

Buff.name: Ghost Walking
Buff.description:
For party members:
Speed +15
Evasion +12
Chance to evade P. Skills +35%
Chance to evade M. Skills +35%
Chance of Blow-Skills +20%.
Can't be used for 30 sec after joining a party.
Can't be applied more than once every 60 seconds.
Effect only works while in a party with the caster.
Only one of these effects can be active at a time: 'Exciting Adventure', 'Wind Riding', or 'Ghost Walking'.

Buff.name: Hide
Buff.description:
Hides the user.
Effect is canceled if any action other than movement is initiated.
Damage of any first attack +15%
Speed -30%.

Buff.name: Hide Mate
Buff.description: Makes a party member invisible. Any action other than moving removes the effect.

Buff.name: Illusion Immersion
Buff.description:
Gives full debuff immunity.
Chance to evade P./M. Skills +25%.
Effect only works when character's HP is below 60%.

Debuff.name: Trick
Debuff.description: Reduces an enemy's aggressive tendencies, causing them to cancel their target.

Debuff.name: Bleed
Debuff.description: Decreases an enemy's Speed by 20%, and inflicts Bleed, causing them to lose 25 HP every second. Inflicts minor damage based on walked distance.

Debuff.name: Stun Shot
Debuff.description:
Supplements the user's P. Atk. with 344 Power to fire an arrow that stuns an enemy.
Over-hit and target cancel are possible.

Debuff.name: Freezing Strike
Debuff.description: Temporarily freezes the surrounding air, inflicting Water damage on an enemy with 26 Power and decreasing their Speed by 20%.

Debuff.name: Veil
Debuff.description: Creates an illusion of nearby monsters.

Debuff.name: Power Break
Debuff.description: Decreases an enemy's P. Atk. by 20%.

Debuff.name: Hex
Debuff.description: Decreases an enemy's P. Def. by 23%.

Debuff.name: Poison
Debuff.description: Poisons the target, causing loss of 24 HP per second. Speed -5%, Incoming Heal Power -7%.

Debuff.name: Bluff
Debuff.description: Deceives an enemy into turning his back, losing his urge to attack and becoming stunned. Target cancel is possible.

Debuff.name: Sand Bomb
Debuff.description: Detonates a sand bomb at nearby enemies, decrease their Accuracy by 6. Has a chance to cancel the target.

Debuff.name: Throwing Dagger
Debuff.description:
Inflicts physical damage. Power: 1142.
Applies to enemy:
Speed -40%.
